a.h: Moderate Rainfall Expected Across Parts of Southern Somalia
a.d: Moderate rainfall, with accumulations of approximately 17 mm, is forecast across Gedo, Lower Jubba, Middle Jubba, and parts of Bay and Lower Shabelle regions. The rainfall may cause localized water accumulation in low-lying areas and locations with poor drainage.
a.ins: Residents are advised to remain cautious in flood-prone and low-lying areas, avoid crossing flooded roads or seasonal watercourses, and follow official weather updates.
a.area: Gedo, Lower Jubba, Middle Jubba, parts of Bay
